Company Description

In the SAP division of Nagarro, we bundle our expertise for critical business applications, complex ERP landscapes & end-to-end solutions. As a leading force in innovation, we stand as the go-to full-service SAP partner for both medium-sized enterprises and large international corporations.

Nagarro helps future-proof your business through a forward-thinking, fluidic, and CARING mindset. We excel at digital engineering and help our clients become human-centric, digital-first organizations, augmenting their ability to be responsive, efficient, intimate, creative, and sustainable. Today, we are 18,500 experts across 40 countries including 2300+ dedicated SAP specialists, forming a Nation of Nagarrians, ready to help our customers succeed.

Job Description

- As a (Senior) Technical Consultant for Linux in the Technical Application Services department, you will be involved in the planning, design and installation of applications and Linux systems in exciting customer projects. 
- You will also provide support in ensuring the operation and further development of existing Linux systems and applications. 
- You will operate standard applications and customers' own developments in a technical environment. 
- In addition, you will be involved in Linux release and patch management and can carry out various other topics in independent projects. 

Qualifications

- You have completed training as an IT specialist for system integration or a comparable qualification and have already gained several years of experience with Enterprise Linux environments. 
- DB2, Oracle or other database solutions are also optional in your portfolio. 
- You have a keen interest in the operation of customer systems and applications, as well as in familiarizing yourself with new topics such as automation. 
- Solution and process-oriented thinking and a confident manner towards customers round off your profile. 
- You speak fluent German and good English. 

  • Service Region: Eastern Europe
